[narrowed from route-edit-504ec48b] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-15eb8508: Edit repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts to make the GET /bootstrap handler derive its anchors from the incoming request instead of returning host-dependent values. The relevant code is the app.get("/bootstrap", ...) handler, in the block that computes identity_endpoint and discovery_endpoint from PUBLIC_IP. If that file is the wrong target, say so rather than editing it.

MEASURED FAILURE. A

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- semantic_reject: The patch modifies the GET /bootstrap handler to derive anchors from the incoming request's Host header as required, and this handler is an executed entrypoint
- wrong_location: The patch modifies the GET /bootstrap handler to derive anchors from the incoming request's Host header instead of using PUBLIC_IP, directly addressing the gap's requirement
- wrong_location: The patch modifies the GET /bootstrap handler to derive identity_endpoint and discovery_endpoint from the incoming request's Host header, which directly addresses the gap of making these anchors reque

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
